scope: First three-scene full-training structural-loss comparison; not the complete paper benchmark.
budget: fine_tracks_v1 with ALL training RGB and training-only SfM incidence; frozen previous coefficients, no fit
growth: 45 common events from step600 to5000; log-linear target counts, MCMC parent/correction unchanged
evaluation: all held-out views, native GRT, per-image PSNR, TorchMetrics SSIM(data_range=1), VGG LPIPS(normalize=True)
limitations: Counter is the development scene; the cap formula was calibrated on historical caps of all9 MipNeRF360 scenes. Do not claim held-out count-estimator validation.
Common5000 growth horizon is an explicit first pipeline setting, not a proven optimal schedule.
Benchmark ray counts follow full strata; rounding differences versus older exact-quota implementations are reported explicitly.
queue: sequential single GPU; fail on nonfinite values, source mismatches or insufficient disk; no hyperparameter selection from evaluation
limits_confirmed_before_launch: Small short-run Counter boundary benefit is not evidence of full-training or held-out-scene improvement.
step_indexing: Native backend is zero-based: the last ADD is step5000, after5001 completed updates; evaluation and checkpoint filenames use completed updates.
changes: Only launch guards and release metadata; training kernels and algorithm unchanged.
